ruleDefinitions.name: Script Event Consumer Spawning Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious child process of Script Event Consumer (scrcons.exe).

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\scrcons\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msbuild\\\.exe$")))
